findings: Ordinary Editor submit records internal history, clears undo/redo, invokes its callback, then clears the draft without an admission result.
Busy steering and follow-up failures restore images but do not restore the cleared text or insert it into the pending queue.
Follow-up clears before reserving an idle run and ignores UserInput channel send failure; the busy branch does not push either ordinary history.
Main Up/Down interception uses TuiState.history, distinct from Editor internal history, so ordinary Up recall of a failed busy submission is not promised.

linkAbortSignal(controller, signal?) returns a detach closure; fallback is Error with name AbortError. raceWithAbortSignal observes rejected abandoned work; sleep retains its listener after normal timeout.
